mismatches.say: Coinsurance: insure at least a set share of the property's value, like eighty percent. Carry less, and every loss gets paid short, in proportion.
mismatches.heard: Coinsurance, ensure at least a set share of the property's value, like 80 percent. Carry less, and every loss gets paid short in proportion.

mismatches.say: Watch out: people away, but belongings still there? That's unoccupied. Look for the stuff.
mismatches.heard: Watch out. People away, but belonging still there. That's unoccupied. Look for the stuff.

mismatches.say: The twenty twelve B P P has its own test: an owner's building is vacant unless at least thirty-one percent of its square footage is in use.
mismatches.heard: The 2012 BPP has its own test, and owners' building is vacant unless at least 31 percent of its square footage is in use.

mismatches.say: A bank holding a home's mortgage is the mortgagee. Under the twenty eleven homeowners form, it brings its own umbrella: it collects despite the owner's denial, if it meets the conditions.
mismatches.heard: A bank holding a home's mortgage is the mortgagee. Under the 2011 Home Owners' Form, it brings its own umbrella. It collects despite the owner's denial if it meets the conditions.
